title: Ask the Path
caption: Everyone she asks has an opinion about her. Neha asks a poll instead. Mira tells her story.
linkedin_text:
A big decision gets a dozen different opinions from a dozen well-meaning friends.

On Waypoint, Ask the Path lets you put one question and two to four options on the Wall; people vote once and everyone sees how the votes split. Mira tells Neha's story; every screen is the real app.

cast.neha: Neha, a young Indian woman in her mid twenties with shoulder-length dark hair, a mustard cardigan and small silver earrings

scenes.clip: Mira, a young woman with long dark hair in a lilac hoodie, facing the camera at a window table in a cosy cafe in the evening, a notebook beside her, a gentle smile.
scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Mira. This is Neha's story. She has a big decision, and every friend gives a different answer.
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Mira. This is Neha's story. She has a big decision, and every friend gives a different answer.
scenes.title: Ask the Path

scenes.clip: {neha} at a cafe table with a laptop showing two email offers, chin on her hand, thoughtful, rain on the window behind her.
scenes.vo: A new city for a new job, or stay close to home. Everyone she asks has an opinion about her, not about the choice.
scenes.sub: A new city for a new job, or stay close to home. Everyone she asks has an opinion about her, not about the choice.

scenes.clip: {neha} on a late evening bus holding her phone, city lights streaking past the window, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: On Waypoint she opens Ask the Path. One question, and two to four options.
scenes.sub: On Waypoint she opens Ask the Path. One question, and two to four options.

scenes.clip: {neha} reading her phone at the cafe table, a small smile, a cup of tea steaming, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: People on the Wall vote once each. No essays. No advice. Just a tap.
scenes.sub: People on the Wall vote once each. No essays. No advice. Just a tap.

scenes.clip: {neha} watching her phone with wide-eyed interest, the cafe warm and blurred behind her.
scenes.vo: She sees how the votes split as they come in.
scenes.sub: She sees how the votes split as they come in.

scenes.clip: {neha} at her apartment window at dusk, the city lights beginning to glow, a calm decided smile.
scenes.vo: It is still her decision. But now she knows how the room leans.
scenes.sub: It is still her decision. But now she knows how the room leans.

scenes.vo: Waypoint. Say it once. Free on Google Play, in many Indian and international languages.
